reason: The Linux OOM killer terminated the lane during compilation. systemd recorded: 'np-symmetry.service: A process of this unit has been killed by the OOM killer' followed by "Failed with result 'oom-kill'". The lane log ends with SignalException signal 15 as torchrun tore down its workers.
note: This receipt was written by hand from the systemd journal and the lane log. The driver could not write it itself: the OOM killer killed the whole unit including the shell, so the '||' failure handler never ran. A lane that dies this way leaves NO artifact unless someone notices the absence.
device_vs_host: This is a HOST memory failure, not a device HBM failure. Trainium1 never got far enough to report an HBM figure.
contrast: trn2 trained the same model successfully on one chip
